In Eur. (see p.vii). Ph. Eur. 6.2 (Nifuroxazide). A bright yellow crystalline powder. Practically insoluble in water; slightly soluble in alcohol; practi- cally insoluble in dichloromethane. Protect from light. Profile Nifuroxazide is an antibacterial that is poorly absorbed from the gastrointestinal tract. It is given orally in a dose of 800 mg daily in divided doses in the treatment of colitis and diarrhoea.
